notes: Secondary witness for the two moves that underwrite quasi-realism (§4): realist-sounding talk of properties, truths and facts comes cheap, and whether that talk is legitimate is itself an evaluative question (#192). Pinned as a web snapshot (#154) because no primary text is pinnable: Blackburn's and Gibbard's works are in copyright with no immutable open text.
